coverage_note: Dated, manually verified public disclosures. Reporting entities, geographies and periods differ. Revenue, systemwide sales and profit are distinct measures; these figures must not be divided by the collected location counts to estimate branch revenue.

gaps.Jollibee: Philippine Jollibee brand revenue and individual branch revenue were not verified. The figures shown cover Jollibee Group worldwide across its brands.
gaps.McDonald's: Individual branch revenue was not verified. FY2024 is the full-year operator disclosure verified here. AGI deconsolidated GADC in March 2025, so its 2025 segment contribution is not a full-year McDonald's Philippines revenue figure.
gaps.KFC: KFC Philippines revenue and individual branch revenue were not verified in the public sources reviewed; no amount is assigned.
